notes.subject: Territory hold / Kristy 2026 call notes
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes say she talked with Jill on May 7, 2026 and sent information for KeizerFEST. Gmail confirms Amy emailed Jill that day after Kristy spoke with her. Historical/contact information only: Oregon territory hold — do not create normal active outreach follow-up. Source: handwritten call notes, page 78; Adventure Zone Gmail.
